ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Heavily skewed towards low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels, with a roughly 1:20 ratio of high-intensity white spots to the dark base pigmentation across the visible surface.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, low-contrast diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe, appearing as thin light-grey scratches against the dark background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge morphology characterized by jagged traumatic notches and potential amputation of small edge segments, particularly on the left lobe tip.
